instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Rank people by the points their activity earns, all time or over the last days, and give each person their level, like a leaderboard", and give it activity (What each person did and when); weights (Points per kind of activity, like {"post": 5, "reply": 1}); metrics; levels.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:rank-people-by-activity and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Give each thing people did ({person, kind, at}), the points each kind is worth (weights), the counts to keep (metrics: {key, label, lookback_days}, null for all time), the levels ({level, name, min_points}) and which count ranks them (rank_by).
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: person-activity (records:list).
